name: dsh-plugin-polish
description: Theme, motion & runtime-performance layer for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI: one motion scale (100/160/200 ms + a single ease-out curve) for both the shell's tokens and the durations plugins hardcode, a :has() replacement engine that turns the ecosystem's most expensive parent selectors into class lookups (measured 4.7 ms -> 0.6 ms per DOM insert), session switching that lands on the bottom instead of sliding, entrance-animation discipline for persistent chrome, scrollbars hidden while scrolling stays native, and third-party surfaces normalized onto the dsw-alias design tokens. Pure CSS/DOM client plugin, no bundle changes.
